integrity: Analytical proof with explicit convex projection certificates; finite numerical quadratic-program checks are corroborative, not a proof of all ranks.
scientific_limitations: Only canonical unscaled coordinates, integer ranks n>=2, and the exact Hausdorff gap and entire farthest locus are claimed; no arbitrary-point nearest-projection formula. Historic priority provisional pending independent literature review.
title: Sharp Euclidean Hausdorff separation and parity of deepest points for Catalan matroid polytopes
